name: filesforsats
short_description: Secure digital file delivery with Lightning payments and cryptographic file verification.
description_md: This project is an LNbits extension that enables merchants to sell digital files through Lightning payments with a secure, privacy-preserving delivery flow. A seller can upload a single file, configure a price, generate a public share link, and require the buyer to validate a private integrity code before the invoice is revealed; once the payment is confirmed, the system unlocks a download endpoint.
